chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Malik ibn Atiyyah, from Sulayman ibn Khalid, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام:
Regarding a Muslim man who was killed and had a Christian father: to whom does his blood money belong?
He عليه السلام said: “It is taken and placed in the treasury of the Muslims, because his liability is upon the treasury of the Muslims.”

key_terms.بَيْتِ مَالِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ: the public treasury of the Muslims

ai.seo_question: Who receives the diyyah of a Muslim killed person if his father is Christian?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the diyyah of a slain Muslim who has no inheriting Muslim heir, since his father is Christian. The Imam عليه السلام rules that the diyyah is to be placed in Bayt al-Mal of the Muslims, linking it to the treasury's legal responsibility in such a case.
